verdict.rationale: Increase documents account holds that reduce the available balance without moving money, and outbound webhooks backed by an Events API that can also be polled. Lifecycle tracking is supported by the Ramp case study, which ingests webhooks for each step of the ACH transfer lifecycle, and by claims of real-time network events and live payment status. missing for 10: an explicit balance-read API showing available vs. pending amounts, detailed webhook documentation enumerating event types for every transaction state change, independent hands-on corroboration.
